## EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec.noOperandLongOptions property

Exact long-option words with no operand, recognized before short-option clusters. Bash's `-restricted` and `-noprofile` are whole long options, not clusters containing `c` or `o`<!-- -->. Unlisted `--name` / `+-name` words are also treated as operand-free; option validity is not checked.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly noOperandLongOptions?: readonly string[];
```
